title: Inference Ecosystem Blindspots & Prospect Prioritizer
creator: Sofia Martinez
description:
Objective: Produce a defensible, prioritized list of 'blindspots' in the current open-model & inference ecosystem that Redwood can exploit for product differentiation and GTM. Deliver a prospect prioritizer rubric that ranks 20–30 target customers/segments by likelihood-to-adopt and strategic value.

Scope: 1) Competitive signal harvest across open models, runtimes, and managed inference providers. 2) Technical blindspot mapping (quantization compatibility, KV cache behavior, runtime kernels, multi-tenant throughput constraints, on-prem packaging friction). 3) Commercial blindspot mapping (licensing, marketplace lock-in, enterprise procurement friction). 4) Prospect scoring rubric (adoption velocity, integration effort, cost arbitrage, compliance fit, strategic value).

Background and motivation: Many of our existing PM artifacts focus on model-sourcing and fallback economics; this ticket targets the intersection between low-level inference engineering trade-offs and enterprise procurement frictions. Hypothesis: There are repeatable areas (e.g., quantized model interoperability, deterministic structured output guarantees, predictable SLA handoffs) where we can craft product positioning and prebuilt integrations to accelerate Dedicated/Private contracts.

Approach and research plan: 1) Kickoff and stakeholder interviews (Solutions, Sales, Eng runtime, Security) to surface top customer pain points. 2) Automated signal collection: scrape model release notes, runtime changelogs, GitHub issues, and cloud marketplace listings for compatibility and licensing flags. 3) Manual triage: synthesize 40–60 signals into 8–10 blindspot themes. 4) Build prospect prioritizer spreadsheet with weighted scoring and short rationale for top 25 prospects. 5) Produce recommendations (productization play, short-term experiments, 3 tactical technical spikes).

Deliverables: - Blindspot map (8–10 themes) with example signals and severity. - Prospect prioritizer matrix (25 prospects) with scored dimensions and one-page rationale for each top-10. - Triage notebook with data sources and scraping code pointers. - 6-slide executive brief for GTM and a 2-week technical quick-win backlog.

Acceptance criteria: - Blindspot map validated by at least 3 Solutions or Sales leads and 2 runtime engineers. - Prioritizer includes 25 prospects with scored rubric and links to supporting signals. - At least one technical quick-win identified and scoped with ENG owner and estimate. - Executive brief reviewed and marked ready for leadership readout.

Success metrics (how we'll measure impact): - Identification of >=3 product hooks that can be converted to sales play collateral within 6 weeks. - Prioritizer used by at least one AE to open a sales conversation (self-reported). - One technical quick-win shipped to experimental branch in Dedicated within 8 weeks.
